name: Vigabatrin
aliases: GVG, 4-Amino-5-hexenoic acid, CPP-109, Gamma vinyl GABA, gamma-vinyl GABA, gamma-Vinyl GABA, gamma-vinyl-gamma-aminobutyric acid, gamma-Vinyl-gamma-aminobutyric acid
summary: Vigabatrin, sold under the brand name Vigafyde among others, is a medication used in the management and treatment of infantile spasms and refractory complex partial seizures.
